program.name: cheap_deletion_bridge
program.rationale: Replace only neighbor packing with demanded deletion packing, retaining the seed's remaining structural measurements. This tests a smaller feature-work change while addressing the displayed interface collision.

program.name: snapshot_gap_blend
program.rationale: Demand full-active-set packing and cover to distinguish snapshot contexts and choose the residual blend. Root-deletion packing supplies the local distinction; the active-set gap controls cover emphasis without identifying cases.

program.name: deletion_pair_bridge
program.rationale: Retain the seed's residual blend while demanding both root-deletion estimates. Reverse the boundary preference and allow a moderate degree correction. Full TRAIN quotient acyclicity remains a hypothesis.

program.name: cover_closed_bridge
program.rationale: Test a cover-led residual estimate against deletion packing and cover. Closed-neighborhood packing adds another demanded structural distinction, with stronger degree compensation for the cover emphasis.

program.name: optimistic_cover_correction
program.rationale: Explore a strongly cover-led score with a small packing-gap penalty and stronger degree compensation. Both deletion estimates remain demanded, while residual edge count preserves another structural distinction.

program.name: interval_clamped_neighbor
program.rationale: Limit the residual packing uplift by the demanded deletion packing-cover gap and residual cover. Neighbor cover replaces the seed's neighbor packing penalty, giving a nonlinear structural alternative without optimal-value calls.

program.name: mixed_deletion_signature
program.rationale: Preserve five seed features and replace residual edge count with a demanded mixed deletion signature. The signature combines packing and cover within one feature slot; it does not certify the complete quotient.

program.name: deletion_margin_structure
program.rationale: Use polynomial residual-minus-deletion margins as opportunity measurements, retaining edge structure and adding closed-neighborhood cover. These demanded margins are heuristic comparisons, not conditional optimal-value guarantees.

program.name: r2_cavity_seed
program.rationale: Retains the seed's completion, triangle and boundary signals while adding delete-root packing sensitivity as a structural discriminator for the failed relations.

program.name: r2_dual_cavity
program.rationale: Uses packing and cover summaries of both inclusion and deletion, with a separate neighborhood gap, to expose distinctions absent from the seed interface.

program.name: r2_closed_sensitivity
program.rationale: Adds closed-neighborhood packing and cover signatures to deletion sensitivity, testing whether local alternatives and their gap clarify the shown conditional preferences.

program.name: r2_weighted_boundary
program.rationale: Tests weighted analogues of boundary, triangle and residual pressure, together with deletion sensitivity, to preserve useful distinctions across the unprinted TRAIN weight regimes.

program.name: attainable_local_exchange
program.rationale: The seed matched degree repair reward on all supplied examples while charging extra feature work. Remove residual covering and prioritize attainable retained reward, discounted by local replacement opportunity.

program.name: r2_dense_cover
program.rationale: Tests greater reliance on cover structure at high relative degree, motivated by the dense source graph failures, while retaining boundary and triangle information.

program.name: r2_conservative_cavity
program.rationale: Tests a conservative inclusion-packing versus deletion-cover margin, penalizes both completion gaps, and retains neighborhood alternatives as demanded structural information.

program.name: r2_gap_switch
program.rationale: Switches completion emphasis using the relative inclusion and deletion gaps, with neighborhood cover and triangles supplying additional distinctions for the strict interface.

program.name: r2_neighbor_profile
program.rationale: Combines neighborhood packing and triangle count in one size-scaled feature, leaving slots for both deletion summaries and residual density.

program.name: local_opportunity_cost
program.rationale: Estimate the opportunity cost of including root from mutually compatible neighbors. Restrict packing and covering to the neighborhood to test whether local exchange information preserves quality with less feature work.

program.name: weighted_edge_discount
program.rationale: Replace packing and covering calls with retained weight discounted by weighted conflict burden. Neighbor and boundary edge losses favor removing overlapping conflicts; maximum weights protect valuable alternatives.

program.name: residual_gap_aversion
program.rationale: Reverse the seed's positive cover-gap contribution: reward feasible retained packing and penalize unresolved cover slack. This targets quality in dense patches such as case_003, where the seed spent substantial work without improving reward.

program.name: average_conflict_surrogate
program.rationale: Approximate retained and blocked packing from weight and average conflict burden, using only set and edge aggregates. The unit-weight examples motivate this inexpensive density surrogate; weighted products supply secondary distinctions.

program.name: density_regime_exchange
program.rationale: Use retained reward more strongly for sparse neighborhoods and blocked feasible reward more strongly for dense neighborhoods. Remove both covering calls while retaining explicit packing guidance and conflict-removal ties.

program.name: cover_compression
program.rationale: Test cover-based objective guidance without greedy packing calls. Discount heavy clique compression and normalize edge products so dense conflict structure influences priorities without overwhelming reward.

program.name: normalized_packing_fraction
program.rationale: Normalize retained packing and blocked opportunity so priorities respond to feasible reward density rather than mostly residual size. This is a quality-focused alternative for the varied sparse and dense supplied graphs.

program.name: context_exclusion_margin
program.rationale: Demands deletion packing, deletion cover and closed-neighborhood packing witnesses, with snapshot context to distinguish states. Tests a retained-versus-deleted packing margin and a mild residual-cover penalty; full quotient acyclicity remains unverified.

program.name: lean_closed_witness
program.rationale: Pairs root-deletion packing with closed-neighborhood packing instead of deletion cover. Tests a cheaper structural alternative with a capped degree correction; neither the displayed join split nor full TRAIN acyclicity is assumed.

program.name: context_seed_conservative
program.rationale: Keeps the seed's packing-cover balance while demanding structural deletion witnesses. The added snapshot terms are constant across roots in a unit-weight snapshot, preserving that part of the local ranking while enriching the interface.

program.name: lean_deletion_cover
program.rationale: Uses deletion packing and cover as the new demanded witness while omitting closed-neighborhood and whole-snapshot calls. Tests whether this cheaper interface suffices for the full quotient and improves the strict inequalities.

program.name: local_cover_gap
program.rationale: Removes whole-snapshot packing calls while retaining deletion and closed-neighborhood witnesses. Penalizes a large residual cover-packing gap as uncertainty in the local feasible completion estimate.

program.name: context_dense_switch
program.rule: weight + 0.7*retained_pack - 0.2*retained_cover - (1.1 if 2*degree > remaining_count-1 else 0.6)*deletion_profile/max(1e-9,abs((remaining_count*remaining_count+weight)*(remaining_count*remaining_count+weight))) - (0.25 if degree > 6 else 0.1)*neighbor_profile/max(1e-9,abs((remaining_count*remaining_count+weight)*(remaining_count*remaining_count+weight))) + 0.2*boundary_edges/max(1e-9,abs(1+degree)) - 0.03*residual_edges/max(1e-9,abs(1+compatible_weight)) + 0.05*degree
program.rationale: Uses the enriched witness interface with stronger exclusion and neighborhood penalties for dense roots. Tests whether density-sensitive priorities improve the dense source graph without changing the shared repair kernel.

program.name: local_degree_rescue
program.rationale: Tests a capped positive degree contribution to counter the displayed low-degree bias, with a penalty beyond degree three. The deletion profile supplies structural distinctions beyond degree and the seed summaries.

program.name: context_boundary_gain
program.rationale: Tests boundary-edge removal as an absolute gain, with exclusion evidence strengthened by the supplied gap constraints. Demands the same expanded structural witnesses while exploring a different repair priority.

program.name: exclusion_bound_advantage
program.rationale: Adds exclusion bounds to distinguish forced inclusion from a favorable residual alone. Neighbor bounds retain an opportunity-cost correction while expanding the demanded interface.

program.name: cover_led_boundary
program.rule: weight + 0.2*residual_pack + 0.8*residual_cover + 0.4*(weight + residual_cover - omit_cover) + 0.4*boundary_edges/max(1e-9,abs(1 + degree)) + 0.35*neighbor_edges/max(1e-9,abs(1 + degree)) - 0.04*residual_edges/max(1e-9,abs(1 + compatible_weight)) - 0.005*degree
program.rationale: Tests whether stronger cover and overlap terms recover preferences missed by the seed's packing-heavy estimate. Exclusion cover adds a conditional comparison to the retained structural statistics.

program.name: weighted_cut_advantage
program.rationale: Replaces unweighted overlap counts with edge weight products, retaining unit-weight structural signals while distinguishing weighted conflict arrangements. Exclusion packing measures conditional gain.

program.name: conservative_dual_margin
program.rationale: Uses the smaller of two inclusion-versus-exclusion estimates to reduce dependence on one polynomial approximation. Neighborhood uncertainty and boundary structure provide additional distinctions.

program.name: closed_neighborhood_stability
program.rationale: Tests a lower-bound-led conditional score with closed-neighborhood opportunity cost. Including the root in neighborhood approximations can expose overlap distinctions absent from neighbor-only features.

program.name: neighbor_clique_compensation
program.rule: weight + 0.4*residual_pack + 0.6*residual_cover + 0.2*(weight + residual_pack - omit_pack) + 0.25*(weight + residual_cover - omit_cover) - 0.1*neighbor_cover + 0.65*neighbor_edges/max(1e-9,abs(1 + degree)) - 0.005*degree
program.rationale: Strengthens compensation for mutually conflicting neighbors, targeting cases where degree alone overstates exclusion cost. Both exclusion bounds remain demanded to distinguish conditional completion estimates.

program.name: residual_weight_pressure
program.rule: weight + 0.3*residual_pack + 0.7*residual_cover + 0.2*(weight + residual_pack - omit_pack) + 0.35*(weight + residual_cover - omit_cover) - 0.18*residual_min_weight/max(1e-9,abs(1 + compatible_weight)) - 0.06*residual_products/max(1e-9,abs(1 + compatible_weight*max(1e-9,abs(max_conflict_weight)))) - 0.005*degree
program.rationale: Combines conditional bounds with two residual conflict-weight summaries. The pressure penalties test whether optimistic completion estimates need stronger correction for conflicts among retained heavy vertices.

program.name: density_adaptive_bounds
program.rule: (weight + 0.2*residual_pack + 0.8*residual_cover + 0.35*(weight + residual_cover - omit_cover) + 0.15*(weight + residual_pack - omit_pack) if 4*degree >= remaining_count or station_gap > 0 or satellite_gap > 0 else weight + 0.8*residual_pack + 0.2*residual_cover + 0.35*(weight + residual_pack - omit_pack) + 0.15*(weight + residual_cover - omit_cover)) - 0.1*neighbor_pack + 0.25*boundary_edges/max(1e-9,abs(1 + degree)) - 0.005*degree
program.rationale: Tests whether dense neighborhoods or nonzero gap constraints benefit from cover-led conditional estimates while sparse states favor packing. Boundary and neighbor terms remain active in both regimes.

program.name: local_redundancy_density
program.rationale: Use local weighted edge evidence to discount neighbors that cannot coexist. Test reward-aware density with six inexpensive features and no packing or cover calls.

program.name: exchange_surplus
program.rationale: Price inclusion against a feasible neighborhood alternative. Test whether neighborhood cover slack and internal conflicts identify redundant competitors worth displacing.

program.name: primal_residual
program.rationale: The shown seed repairs matched degree rewards. Emphasize feasible residual packing while retaining modest cover guidance and removing boundary and residual-edge scans.

program.name: residual_edge_certificate
program.rationale: Replace residual packing and cover with a conservative edge-minimum reward certificate. Use neighborhood packing to price feasible exchanges and weighted residual edges to break ties.

program.name: deletion_primal_regret
program.rationale: Compare retained, deletion-only and full-set feasible packings to estimate inclusion regret and root sensitivity. Accept extra packing work as a distinct quality hypothesis.

program.name: boundary_primal
program.rationale: Keep feasible residual packing and the seed's boundary-exposure mechanism. Replace cover and neighborhood packing with edge and cardinality statistics to test lower feature work.

program.name: density_ambiguity_switch
program.rationale: Test a density-dependent blend of residual feasible packing and cover. Penalize primal-dual ambiguity in both retained and displaced sets.

program.name: deletion_dual_regret
program.rationale: Compare retained and deletion-only cover estimates to penalize their drop under inclusion. Use neighborhood packing as a feasible exchange witness and retain a heavy residual alternative.

program.name: closed_cover_gap
program.rationale: Emphasizes the inclusion-versus-deletion cover gap when residual greedy packing may be weak, with a closed-neighborhood uncertainty penalty and demanded deletion distinctions.

program.name: packing_regret
program.rationale: Rewards roots whose deletion damages a global feasible packing; the global summary also supplies a demanded snapshot distinction across TRAIN states.

program.name: sparse_alias_flip
program.rationale: Tests a sparse-state cover reversal together with deletion packing, addressing conflicting witnessed rankings without assuming that either deletion feature resolves every TRAIN join.

program.name: cover_regret
program.rationale: Tests cover-dominated marginal ranking with neighborhood cover loss; deletion packing remains demanded to challenge aliases that cover summaries alone might retain.

program.name: robust_gain
program.rationale: Uses independently expressed deletion gains and a nonlinear conservative combination, retaining both residual summaries while testing local packing and cover distinctions.

program.name: seed_delete_tilt
program.rationale: Typed aggregates preserve the seed terms while making both root-deletion summaries demanded distinctions; full TRAIN acyclicity remains unverified.

program.name: snapshot_bracket
program.rationale: Demands packing and cover summaries for the residual, deletion and whole snapshot, testing whether broader state distinctions remove quotient cycles beyond the displayed joins.

program.name: deletion_pack_rebalance
program.rationale: Add a root-deletion packing contrast while retaining the seed summaries through an integer encoding of neighbor and boundary counts. Favor neighbor compression with a small boundary penalty.

program.name: weighted_boundary_gap
program.rationale: Combines demanded deletion distinctions with weighted cross-boundary conflict mass, extending the seed boundary idea to weighted TRAIN families without treating polynomial summaries as optimal completions.

program.name: packing_boundary_density
program.rationale: Drop the residual cover to reduce full-set feature work. Use feasible completion packing, deletion contrasts, and normalized conflict densities to guide the shared repair kernel.

program.name: cover_uncertainty_contrast
program.rationale: Lead with the completion upper bound while discounting its packing gap. Add neighborhood upper and lower bounds to represent uncertainty in the weight displaced by choosing root.

program.name: conditional_lower_contrast
program.rationale: Emphasize a feasible conditional completion estimate against both deletion bounds. Separately reward internal neighbor conflicts and penalize boundary coupling.

program.name: deletion_cover_rebalance
program.rationale: Use the root-deletion upper bound to distinguish similar seed interfaces. Increase completion-cover influence and neighborhood compression without treating completion certificates as patch guarantees.

program.name: closed_neighborhood_contrast
program.rationale: Include root in the local packing and covering sets to expose competition between root and its neighbors. Balance these local opportunity costs against conditional completion and deletion bounds.

program.name: interval_gap_switch
program.rationale: Reduce reliance on the conditional upper bound when its gap exceeds the deletion gap. Demand total conflict count as a snapshot signature and density normalization.

program.name: edge_release
program.rationale: Replace packing and covers with edge summaries to test whether a strong low-degree bias preserves feasible repair reward with less charged feature work.

program.name: residual_lower
program.rationale: Prioritize an explicit feasible completion and penalize blocked packing value; replace the seed's residual cover with a cheaper weighted neighborhood edge summary.

program.name: local_exchange
program.rationale: Estimate the opportunity cost of inclusion from neighborhood packing, discount uncertain neighborhood certificates, and avoid computing residual packing or covers.

program.name: weighted_release
program.rationale: Test a packing-free weighted objective that distinguishes conflicts between valuable vertices using minimum-weight and product-weight edge summaries.

program.name: tight_completion
program.rationale: Reverse the seed's optimistic cover contribution into a certificate-gap penalty, testing whether reliable completions improve bounded repair and reduce search work.

program.name: cover_density
program.rationale: Use cover-based completion potential without greedy packing, discounting optimism by residual conflict density and charging blocked neighborhood cover value.

program.name: encoded_topology_contrast
program.rationale: Encode neighbor, residual, and total edge counts in one demanded feature, retaining seed topology information alongside both deletion bounds. Its scalar contribution favors neighbor compression and lightly penalizes residual conflicts.

program.name: dual_certificate
program.rationale: Keep modest residual optimism while adding a neighborhood certificate-gap penalty, testing whether better opportunity-cost estimates justify the additional cover work.

program.name: density_switch
program.rationale: Use a snapshot-wide density switch to preserve degree-led choices in sparse patches and prioritize certified feasible completion in denser patches.

program.name: w3_delete_delta
program.rationale: Warm-start the completion blend with demanded include-versus-delete packing and cover contrasts. Encode residual, neighbor and total edge counts together to retain structural distinctions within six features.

program.name: w3_conservative_margin
program.rationale: Emphasize the conservative inclusion packing versus deletion cover margin, while retaining an optimistic contrast. Both deletion summaries are demanded to expose distinctions hidden by the shown seed joins.

program.name: w3_pack_regret
program.rationale: Favor an attainable inclusion completion relative to a blended deletion alternative. A small cover-gap term explores uncertain completions, with degree-normalized neighbor opportunity cost.

program.name: w3_completion_ratio
program.rationale: Normalize inclusion completions by root-deletion alternatives to reduce sensitivity to graph reward scale. Packing and cover deletion summaries both affect the nonlinear ranking.

program.name: w3_gap_damping
program.rationale: Start from packing regret and damp inclusion optimism using both completion gaps. Penalize uncertainty in the deletion alternative rather than trusting a large cover value alone.

program.name: w3_saturated_margin
program.rationale: Represent deletion summaries by their sum and gap, then saturate signed inclusion advantages. This limits domination by large margins while keeping both deletion distinctions active.

program.name: w3_gain_tiers
program.rule: (2+include_pack_gain if include_pack_gain > 1e-8 else (1+include_cover_gain if include_cover_gain > 1e-8 else 0.1*include_pack_gain+0.05*include_cover_gain)) + 0.02*(weight+0.6*residual_pack+0.4*residual_cover) - 0.01*neighbor_pack - 0.001*degree - 0.0001*edge_code/max(1e-9,abs(remaining_count*remaining_count*remaining_count*remaining_count))
program.rationale: Make inclusion-minus-deletion gains explicit typed features and prioritize positive packing gains before cover gains. The completion blend supplies a finer ranking within these heuristic tiers.

program.name: w3_gap_gate
program.rationale: Choose a conservative or optimistic inclusion-versus-deletion contrast according to relative completion gaps. Both deletion features influence the gate and ranking; full TRAIN quotient acyclicity remains for controller assessment.

program.name: cover_skip
program.rationale: Favor full-residual cover estimates with include-versus-skip corrections. Radix summaries retain unit-weight neighborhood bounds and all three edge counts within six demanded features.

program.name: pack_skip
program.rationale: Test a conservative feasible-completion priority with stronger packing margins and explicit displaced packing. The topology summary retains residual, neighborhood and root-excluded edge counts.

program.name: uncertainty_switch
program.rationale: Shift toward the cover estimate when residual bound disagreement exceeds the root reward; otherwise trust feasible packing. Include-versus-skip estimates supply additional structural distinctions.

program.name: regret_consensus
program.rationale: Reward agreement between packing and cover inclusion margins through their minimum. Independent margin expressions retain both skip estimates without referencing custom features.

program.name: interval_conservative
program.rationale: Penalize loose residual completion intervals while emphasizing the cover-based inclusion margin. Sum and gap preserve the two residual bounds as separate recoverable coordinates.

program.name: product_edge_skip
program.rationale: Test pairwise reward pressure as a weighted structural separator with cover-led completion and mild displaced-packing cost. The product summary equals the count summary on unit-weight states.

program.name: weighted_edge_skip
program.rationale: Use minimum-endpoint conflict costs to distinguish weighted residual structures while preserving the count summary on unit-weight states. Completion and skip bounds remain primary.

program.name: b3obj_exchange_margin
program.rationale: Subtracting neighborhood feasible and covering alternatives estimates exchange regret. Retained density and maximum surviving reward provide inexpensive completion signals.

program.name: b3obj_local_ratio
program.rationale: The shown seed matches degree repair quality while incurring substantial dense-graph feature work. Neighborhood packing ratios and edge summaries may preserve quality without retained-set packing or cover calls.

program.name: closed_resource
program.rationale: Add closed-neighborhood packing to the neighbor bound summary to expose root-versus-neighbor greedy ordering. Positive resource gaps select a more optimistic residual completion mixture.

program.name: b3obj_feasible_completion
program.rationale: Use retained feasible packing as the main completion objective, replacing the seed's retained cover with a smaller neighborhood cover to price displaced alternatives.

program.name: b3obj_weighted_density
program.rationale: Replace retained packing and cover calls with weighted density proxies that reduce to n*n/(n+2*m) on nonempty unit-weight retained sets. One neighborhood packing still prices displacement.

program.name: b3obj_degree_tempered_gap
program.rationale: Favor realized retained packing and attenuate its cover gap with degree. This may limit dense-graph optimism while preserving sparse-graph flexibility and eliminating boundary-edge construction.

program.name: b3obj_optimistic_completion
program.rationale: Retained clique cover supplies an optimistic completion signal. Edge density and neighborhood cover cost temper that optimism while removing the retained greedy-packing call.

program.name: b3obj_clipped_optimism
program.rationale: Cap the residual cover bonus by root reward, price neighborhood uncertainty, and reward boundary release. This may prevent uncertain completion value from dominating the feasible estimate.

program.name: b3obj_include_exclude
program.rationale: Contrast root inclusion and exclusion completion estimates to prioritize favorable marginal reward. The extra packing and cover work is a quality-focused hypothesis under the shared repair caps.

program.name: deletion_regret
program.rationale: Retains the seed completion blend while demanding root-deletion packing and cover distinctions. Inclusion-versus-deletion contrasts and closed-neighborhood cover may separate the displayed joins; full quotient acyclicity remains unverified.

program.name: deletion_support
program.rationale: Tests positive deletion support as an alternative to inclusion regret. Both root-deletion summaries and both closed-neighborhood summaries are demanded, providing structural information absent from the seed interface.

program.name: neighbor_cover_gap
program.rationale: Places more weight on feasible residual packing and penalizes the neighbor cover-packing gap. Root-deletion features remain demanded to address information lost in the displayed equality joins.

program.name: cut_density_regret
program.rationale: Combines root-deletion distinctions with a compact edge statistic counting neighbor-internal and neighbor-to-residual edges. Preserves the seed's residual-density correction while changing the demanded interface.

program.name: motif_cover_regret
program.rationale: Uses a stronger inclusion-versus-deletion contrast alongside neighbor-edge and closed-cover information. This tests whether compact conflict motifs improve priority without relying on IDs or conditional optimal-value calls.

program.name: global_gap_context
program.rationale: Demands global packing and cover context through an interaction with the root-dependent residual gap. Deletion summaries supply root distinctions, while the interaction tests whether completion-bound uncertainty should alter priorities across snapshots.

program.name: weighted_cut_regret
program.rationale: Extends the deletion distinction with weighted boundary and neighbor-edge summaries. These reduce to structural edge counts on unit graphs and can expose additional distinctions on weighted TRAIN states.

program.name: density_bound_switch
program.rationale: Tests a structural density switch: favor constructive packing in sparse retained graphs and cover estimates in dense ones. Root-deletion packing supplies additional demanded action information.

program.name: gap_gated_exchange
program.rationale: Changes the completion blend when the residual cover-packing gap is large and demands the closed-versus-open neighborhood packing contrast. Root-deletion features remain active in both branches; no quotient or scalar-fit success is assumed.

program.name: neighbor_interval
program.rationale: Adds a neighborhood packing interval to distinguish tightly conflicting neighbors from mutually compatible opportunity loss. Tests whether greater residual-cover emphasis repairs the seed's completion underestimates.

program.name: interval_margin
program.rationale: Tests a cover-led completion estimate augmented by root-exclusion margins. Demanded deletion bounds may distinguish structural aliases, while neighborhood packing and boundary relief retain local context.

program.name: global_gap_discount
program.rationale: Uses the whole snapshot's packing interval to calibrate the residual lower-bound discount. Tests whether snapshot context improves rankings across states without using IDs or family lookups.

program.name: cover_density_relief
program.rationale: Retains the seed's six demanded structural features while shifting toward residual cover and stronger conflict relief. Tests scalar repair without introducing additional feature operations.

program.name: cohesive_weighted_degree
program.rationale: Test degree-based packing with neighbor cohesion and residual sparsity corrections. Removing all packing and cover features targets the seed's large dense-graph feature charge.

program.name: single_pack_completion
program.rationale: Rank by an explicit feasible completion after including the root, using one packing call and no covers. Cheap cohesion terms provide alternative tie breaks in the unit-weight TRAIN graphs.

program.name: inclusion_bound_witness
program.rationale: Adds full-residual include/exclude bound gaps, including a positive lower-include versus upper-exclude witness. These are ranking signals at the current boundary, not restricted-patch pivot guarantees.

program.name: neighbor_opportunity_guard
program.rationale: Estimate the feasible reward sacrificed among immediate conflicts and penalize uncertainty in that estimate. Confine packing and cover computations to the neighborhood.

program.name: closed_neighborhood_loss
program.rationale: Measures opportunity loss using the closed neighborhood's packing interval, incorporating the root's competition with its neighbors. Root-exclusion packing and boundary structure provide complementary distinctions.

program.name: cover_density_completion
program.rationale: Test optimistic residual capacity with edge-density penalties instead of the seed's mixed packing estimate. A single cover call offers a different quality and work tradeoff.

program.name: heavy_rival_margin
program.rationale: Protect against excluding a heavier immediate rival while retaining low-degree and cohesion preferences. Use aggregate and maximum-weight features to seek lower work across unit and weighted families.

program.name: relative_interval_switch
program.rationale: Tests whether relative include/exclude interval tightness should select the completion estimate. Both deletion bounds are demanded, with retained and neighborhood edge counts supplying inexpensive structural refinements.

program.name: density_switch_completion
program.rationale: Use feasible completion in denser neighborhoods and a degree-first score in sparse ones, reflecting the different TRAIN conflict regimes. Both branches share two packing features and omit covers.

program.name: boundary_release_priority
program.rationale: Emphasize removal of conflicts connecting the excluded neighborhood to the retained set. This structural alternative targets stalled dense-source repairs without packing or cover calls.

program.name: conservative_completion_gap
program.rationale: Reverse the seed's optimistic cover-gap preference by favoring supported feasible completion reward. Retain neighborhood opportunity and boundary cues as a quality-first hypothesis.

scope: No original production assessor/kernel/scorer/oracle/loader is imported or executed.
All raw positions, missing/invalid/error/capped outcomes and actual scalar/quotient/quality/work observations remain distinct.
Complete non-cap traces reuse only the frozen independent R1 mathematical verifier; partial traces retain unknown bounds and feasible prefixes.
Costs/times are saved charged proxies and actual receipts, never substituted with verifier timings.
R1's failed12-winner barrier remains immutable; R2 independently requires four genuine witness joint winners.
Uniform quality-only comparators do not inherit certificate consistency or count as proposed-method winners.
No candidate tuning, replacement, production TRAIN reexecution or TEST query/evaluation is performed.
